gate_verbatim: Under an adversarial battery of malformed physical-space inputs (NaN-seeded vorticity, degenerate/zero stream function, extreme grid-stretching), does solver/boussinesq.py ever silently return a finite, plausible-looking result instead of propagating or flagging the invalid input?
silent_corruption_definition: returns normally AND outcome/conservation_drift/mean_drift/energy_balance_residual/max_omega are all finite and plausible AND the run is invalid, because the returned state is non-finite or an invalid parameter was silently dropped while params records it. Pre-committed in writeup/novelty/leg_89.md section 3 before the run.
